verdict.rationale: Docs state that several core workflows work in either the web app or the API: screening configurations (docs-6), and review and remediation of cases, alerts and risks (docs-20). Customer creation, sync/async/batch screening, webhook management and a downloadable OpenAPI schema/Postman collection are also documented (docs-1, docs-10, docs-13, docs-15, docs-16). However, there is no explicit UI/API parity claim, and API credentials are documented as generated in the web app (docs-5), a concrete UI-only function. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, API-based credential/access management, evidence that risk-score equation configuration is available via API, and independent corroboration.
